title: I would not have voted for Zionism motion, Polanski says
description: A motion declaring Zionism a form of racism was passed by Green Party members on Sunday.

title: Chris Mason: Questions remain for Green Party leader Zack Polanski
description: Senior party figures have criticised his response to a motion passed by members declaring Zionism a form of racism.

title: Firing squad execution to be livestreamed, Pentagon says
description: Pete Hegseth says the execution will be public, but a legal expert says the "unprecedented" decision is on "uncertain legal terrain".

title: Emotions run high at the round table as Celebrity Traitors banish two players
description: Viewers watched to see whether Richard E Grant could save himself at the first round table of the series.

title: £15m spent cleaning illegal waste supersite in ancient woodland
description: Concerns remain over the ancient Kent woodland's future after 39,500 tonnes of rubbish were cleared.

title: Russian strikes and approaching winter force some in Kyiv to pack bags and flee
description: A renewed Russian campaign of strikes on power and energy infrastructure has made some contemplate leaving Ukraine's capital.

title: Everton owners consider selling club two years after takeover
description: Everton owners the Friedkin Group are exploring the sale of the club less than two years after taking control.

title: Suspect linked to Monaco bomb attack on millionaire speaks to BBC
description: Vitalii Zhykovych gives his own account of the attempted assassination of Ukrainian-born businessman Vadym Yermolayev.

title: Mark Zuckerberg has an image problem - so why is Meta's business booming?
description: A new film paints the Meta founder as a villain. But the tech firm seems immune to bad publicity, writes our North America tech correspondent.
